q1.q: Is AI-written content a problem for Google?
q1.a: Google looks at whether content is helpful and accurate, not how it was produced. Kitisel fact-checks every article, cites sources and asks for your approval before publishing. We don’t promise rankings; consistent, quality content pays off over time.

q2.q: Which platforms does it work with?
q2.a: It publishes directly to WordPress, Shopify, Webflow, Ghost and Wix. Custom sites can connect via webhook, or you can download articles as HTML, Markdown or ZIP.

q3.q: Will articles go live without my approval?
q3.a: Not by default. In approval mode every article comes to you first; you can edit, rewrite or reject it. If you like, you can turn on automatic publishing for articles that pass the quality bar.

q4.a: A 25-point technical SEO check, your brand summary, the keywords your customers search for and topic clusters. No sign-up needed; the report opens at a shareable link.

q5.q: Which languages can it write in?
q5.a: The dashboard is in English, Turkish, German, Spanish and French. Articles are written in 25+ languages, tailored to your target country.

q6.q: How do cancellation and refunds work?
q6.a: Cancel your subscription from the dashboard at any time. You get a full refund within 14 days of your first payment.

about.title: About us
about.intro: Kitisel was built to help small businesses and agencies publish regular, high-quality content that people actually search for.
about.p1: We analyze your site, find what your customers search for on Google and prepare a content calendar. Every article is written in your brand voice, fact-checked, linked to your other pages and published on your site with your approval.
about.p2: We don’t forget your existing posts either: for posts that are losing traffic or getting outdated, we suggest updates, show you the before and after, and apply them only if you approve.
about.p3: Kitisel is currently in beta. Your feedback directly shapes the product; we read every suggestion.
